 Korea Town by Boutiqaat Accelerates GCC Expansion with Two Store Openings in Qatar
 Oleh PR NEWSWIRE 
 2 November 2026, 1:19 am 
 Share on facebook 
 Share on twitter 
 Share on whatsapp 
 Share on email 
 Share on telegram 
 Share on linkedin 
 HAWALLY, Kuwait , Nov. 2, 2026 /PRNewswire/ — Korea Town by Boutiqaat, the #1 destination for Korean beauty, continues its ambitious GCC expansion with the successful opening of two stores in Qatar, located at Mall of Qatar and Place Vendôme .
 Korea town by Boutiqaat 
 Following its first international store opening at The Avenues Bahrain, Korea Town has further strengthened its regional presence through its online channel on the Boutiqaat App and stores across Kuwait, Qatar and Bahrain.
 Korea Town brings together a curated selection of Korea’s most sought-after skincare, makeup, wellness and lifestyle brands, offering customers exclusive product launches, innovative beauty experiences and access to the latest K-Beauty trends.
 Souha Hasan, General Manager of Korea Town by Boutiqaat, commented: 
 "Our expansion into Bahrain and Qatar marks an exciting milestone in Korea Town’s journey. With our growing presence across the GCC and more openings on the horizon, our vision is to bring the very best of Korean beauty to new markets while establishing Korea Town as the region’s ultimate K-Beauty destination." 
 With further store openings planned across the GCC, Korea Town by Boutiqaat continues to strengthen its partnerships with Korean beauty brands, creating new opportunities to introduce innovative products and experiences to consumers throughout the Middle East.
 About Korea Town by Boutiqaat 
 Korea Town by Boutiqaat is a leading Korean beauty, wellness and lifestyle retail destination, with an online channel on the Boutiqaat App and stores across Kuwait, Bahrain and Qatar, with ambitious plans for continued expansion throughout the GCC.
